FOUNDING FAMILIES

Your offer.
Clearly explained.

Founding-family reservations are open. The reservation terms are below. Opening a page does not reserve a place. Reserve now on the secure checkout page.

The proposed price and benefits

  • ₹100 inclusive of applicable tax to reserve access for your child.
  • One introductory month included when access is activated.
  • ₹1,399 per month for the first six paid months, instead of the standard ₹1,499 monthly price.
  • The ₹100 reservation payment is credited toward the first paid bill, making that bill ₹1,299.
  • The next five paid monthly bills are ₹1,399 each. The planned price thereafter is ₹1,499 per month.

The six discounted months provide ₹600 in subscription savings. The reservation credit is your own advance payment applied to a bill, not an additional discount.

When access begins

The introductory month starts when the child’s access is activated, not on the reservation date. Launch is planned for December 2026–January 2027. This is a pre-launch reservation, not immediate product access. Phase 1 capacity is limited to 5,000 students; this number is not a live remaining-place count. The exact activation date will be communicated to reservation holders; the missed-launch refund guarantee applies.

Refunds and cancellation

Parents can cancel before the launch deadline for a full ₹100 refund. Our team initiates eligible refunds within 24 hours of receiving the cancellation request; bank or payment-provider settlement time is additional. If Into3 has not launched by 31 January 2027, the ₹100 reservation is fully refundable. Refunds are manually processed by our team. Use your private reservation link or email orders@into3.ai. This reservation does not authorise automatic subscription charges. These terms apply specifically to the founding-family reservation.

Privacy and support

Read the existing Privacy Policy. This landing page does not collect student answers, health data or registration details. Contact info@into3.ai with questions, or refund@into3.ai for billing and refund enquiries.
